title: Inference Cooperative — AI, governed together
excerpt: A member-governed cooperative for AI inference. Direct the models, the values, and the direction — together.
content_html:
inference.coop

AI, governed together.

We don't have to accept the choices Big Tech gives us. We can make our own.

Member-governed Open source Privacy options Renewable options

AI is becoming infrastructure.

The models shaping how we work, learn, and talk are owned by a handful of companies — and governed first for their shareholders' profit.

We think that's backwards. A tool this consequential should answer to the people who use it. So we're enabling access to AI on the users' terms.

One membership. A fair price, a full seat.

Everyone joins the same way, and everyone gets the same things — the difference is what you can afford to give, not what you get back.

Pay what's fair

Dues are a sliding scale starting at $5 a month — you choose the amount that fits your circumstances. (Many members pay $15.)

Everyone gets the same allowance

Today, every member gets a $15 monthly credit for chat and API alike, whether you pay $5 or $20.

Need more? Add credits

When the allowance isn't enough, buy a credit pack. Credits never expire, carry over month to month, and kick in only after your allowance is used.

Chat, API, and a vote

One membership opens the chat, the developer API, and a seat in governance.

Leave any time

Cancel whenever you like. Your data stays yours.

Pricing is itself a co-op decision. As usage grows, the current scale will need to change — and members will decide how, together.

Choose by what you value.

Different members care about different things. So we let you choose your AI by the values that matter to you — not lock you to a single provider.

Privacy

Models running in encrypted enclaves, so even we can't read your prompts or responses.

Renewable energy

Models served on 100% renewable power, for members who want their AI to be lighter on the planet.

Publicly developed

Open, sovereign models built as public goods rather than proprietary products.

The exact lineup changes as the co-op decides.

Chat

Your own chat, tuned to the value you pick.

  • Web search built in
  • File uploads & documents
  • Pick the model and provider each time

Developer API

Bring your own tools, through a standard endpoint.

  • OpenAI-compatible
  • Your own API keys
  • Shares the same monthly allowance

Help run the AI you use.

Join the cooperative, and help decide where it goes next.
